1.explanation: Both DrilldownBreadcrumbs.js and DrilldownOverlayBehavior.js register click handlers that call canvas.setRootElement(canvas.findRoot(planeId(element)) …). After the root is changed (e.g. drilling into a subprocess), canvas.findRoot can return undefined for the parent plane, causing setRootElement(undefined) and the “rootElement required” error. These files need to be updated so the drill-out logic correctly locates and passes the parent/root element when changing back to the parent process.
1.bug_scenario: In the BPMN modeler the user collapses a subprocess (inside a pool), then clicks the drill-down overlay (or uses the breadcrumb) to navigate into that subprocess. Once inside, clicking the breadcrumb or overlay to drill back out throws “Uncaught Error: rootElement required” because the click handler calls canvas.setRootElement(undefined) – the drill-out logic doesn’t correctly pick up the parent/root plane after the root was changed.
